title: What Bluey Character Type Are You?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your Bluey-inspired personality type!

questions.text: When planning a weekend activity with your loved ones, you would most likely...

options.text: Pick a familiar picnic spot you’ve visited dozens of times, packing all your go-to snacks
Organize a big backyard obstacle course where everyone can join in and cheer each other on
Suggest a quiet afternoon of reading or building a blanket fort with one close friend
Come up with a wild imaginary quest, like searching for a mythical 'rainbow bone' in the neighborhood

questions.text: When you make a mistake during a game, your first reaction is to...

options.text: Laugh it off and turn the mistake into a silly new rule for the game
Apologize immediately and check if anyone feels hurt or upset by what happened
Figure out exactly what went wrong and adjust your strategy to avoid it next time
Insist on starting over from the beginning to follow the original rules perfectly

questions.text: When a friend shares big news with you, you...

options.text: Help them list out practical steps to handle whatever comes next
Celebrate loudly, maybe even throw an impromptu party to mark the occasion
Listen closely and ask detailed questions about how they’re feeling
Nod along quietly, taking time to process the news before responding

questions.text: When you have to finish a task before bedtime, you...

options.text: Follow a strict checklist you made earlier, checking off each step one by one
Wing it, doing parts as you go and seeing where the creative flow takes you
Focus on the most important parts first to make sure it gets done well
Brainstorm a new way to do it that’s more fun and exciting than the usual method

questions.text: If you found a mysterious box in the park, you would...

options.text: Ask a park ranger to help you return it to its rightful owner immediately
Bring it home and examine every detail to figure out what’s inside and where it came from
Gather your friends to make up stories about who it belongs to and what’s inside
Decide it’s probably trash and dispose of it properly to keep the park clean

questions.text: When you’re feeling bored at home, you...

options.text: Spend the afternoon rearranging your toy collection into a new, organized display
Curl up with a favorite book or draw pictures in your sketchbook alone
Call up several friends to come over and play a rowdy game of keep-away
Create a new imaginary world with your stuffed animals and act out an adventure

questions.text: When playing a team game, you take on the role of...

options.text: The one who sticks to the tried-and-true plays that you know will work
The one who comes up with weird, unexpected plays that catch everyone off guard
The one who makes sure everyone knows their job and stays on track with the plan
The one who cheers on teammates and makes sure no one feels left out

questions.text: When your favorite toy breaks, you...

options.text: Turn it into a completely new toy, like using the broken parts to build a robot
Try to fix it using whatever supplies you have around the house
Cry and seek comfort from a parent or close friend
Replace it with a new one that has all the same features you loved

questions.text: When planning a surprise for someone, you...

options.text: Plan every minute of the surprise down to the last detail to make it perfect
Invite all their friends to a big party with their favorite cake and games
Go with the flow, adjusting the surprise based on how they’re feeling in the moment
Make a handwritten card and a small, thoughtful gift just for them alone

questions.text: When you have to choose between two activities, you...

options.text: Choose the one you know you’ll enjoy because you’ve done it many times
Pick the one you’ve never tried before to see what it’s like
Choose the one that lets you have quiet time to yourself or with one person
Pick the one that lets you spend time with as many people as possible

questions.text: When you disagree with a friend about a game rule, you...

options.text: Compromise by making a new rule that works for both of you
Insist on following the exact rules as written to keep things fair
Let them win to keep the game going and avoid a fight
Argue your point using the official rulebook to prove you’re right

questions.text: When you think about the future, you most often imagine...

options.text: Quiet days spent doing your favorite activities, like reading or gardening
A stable routine where you know exactly what to expect each day
Hanging out with lots of friends and having big, exciting adventures every day
A life full of new inventions and creative projects no one has ever done before

results.title: The Bandit Adventurer
results.description: You’re the life of every gathering, turning ordinary afternoons into wild, imaginary quests just like Bandit. You thrive on making others laugh, embrace chaos as part of the fun, and always see the magic in small moments. Friends love your creativity and warmth, and you never run out of new ideas to explore.

results.title: The Chilli Caregiver
results.description: Like Chilli, you’re the heart of your friend group—always looking out for others and making sure everyone feels included. You organize fun activities that bring people together, listen closely when someone needs to talk, and have a knack for turning tough moments into learning opportunities. Your kindness makes you everyone’s go-to confidant.

results.title: The Bluey Strategist
results.description: You’re a natural leader, just like Bluey when she’s planning a game. You love coming up with clever strategies, setting clear goals, and motivating others to follow along. You’re quick to solve problems and never shy away from taking charge, but you always make sure everyone has fun while achieving the group’s objectives.

results.title: The Bingo Innovator
results.description: Bingo’s playful curiosity is your middle name! You love questioning the status quo, coming up with weird and wonderful game variations, and debating ideas with friends. You’re always one step ahead with a new trick or twist, and your friends admire how you turn even the most boring tasks into something exciting and unexpected.

results.title: The Lila Party Planner
results.description: You live for the moment, just like Lila! You love throwing big, energetic parties, trying new foods, and dancing around the backyard with everyone. You’re always ready to jump into a new game or adventure, and your infectious energy makes every day feel like a celebration. Friends know they can count on you to make any occasion memorable.

results.title: The Nana Nurturer
results.description: Like Nana, you’re the one who remembers everyone’s favorite snacks, helps with scraped knees, and makes sure everyone feels at home. You thrive on taking care of others, following beloved traditions, and creating warm, cozy moments for your loved ones. Your thoughtfulness and reliability make you the glue that holds your group together.

results.title: The Uncle Rad Organizer
results.description: Uncle Rad’s no-nonsense approach is your style! You love following rules, organizing games with clear plans, and making sure everything runs smoothly. You’re practical, dependable, and always have a backup plan ready. Friends know they can trust you to keep things on track and make sure everyone plays fairly.

results.title: The Muffin Daredevil
results.description: You’re bold, adventurous, and always ready for a challenge—just like Muffin! You love trying risky stunts, exploring new places, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. You’re quick to think on your feet, and your fearless attitude makes you the first to jump into any new game or adventure that comes your way.

results.title: The Indy Dreamer
results.description: Indy’s quiet imagination is your superpower! You love spending time alone with your books, drawing pictures of imaginary worlds, and writing stories about magical creatures. You’re deeply kind and empathetic, and you often notice small details others miss. Friends admire your creativity and the way you see the world through a unique, gentle lens.

results.title: The Franny Wise Guide
results.description: Like Franny, you’re a wise, thoughtful friend who always knows the right thing to say. You spend time listening to others’ problems and offering quiet, meaningful advice. You have a deep understanding of people’s feelings, and you often know what someone needs before they even ask. Your calm presence makes others feel safe and supported.

results.title: The Mackenzie Mastermind
results.description: Mackenzie’s clever planning is your specialty! You love thinking ahead, coming up with complex strategies, and solving tricky problems. You’re independent, focused, and always have a long-term goal in mind. Friends admire your intelligence and the way you can turn even the most chaotic situation into a well-organized plan.

results.title: The Rusty Problem-Solver
results.description: Rusty’s curious mind is just like yours! You love taking things apart to see how they work, asking endless questions, and debating ideas with your closest friends. You’re independent, analytical, and always looking for new ways to solve problems. Your friends count on you to come up with clever solutions when things get tough.

results.title: The Coco Creative
results.description: Coco’s artistic spirit flows through you! You love spending time painting, drawing, or making crafts with your hands. You’re quiet, gentle, and find joy in the small, beautiful moments of life. Friends love your unique perspective and the way you turn ordinary objects into works of art that make everyone smile.

results.title: The Honey Helper
results.description: Like Honey, you’re the one who always offers a helping hand. You love cooking for your friends, tidying up the playroom, and making sure everyone has everything they need. You’re reliable, kind, and thrive on taking care of others. Your friends know they can always count on you to be there when they need you most.

results.title: The Jax Rule-Follower
results.description: Jax’s careful, methodical approach is your go-to! You love following established rules, sticking to routines, and making sure everything is done correctly. You’re practical, dependable, and always keep your promises. Friends admire your responsibility and the way you make sure games are played fairly and safely for everyone.

results.title: The Jack Tinkerer
results.description: Jack’s hands-on skills are your superpower! You love building things, fixing broken toys, and figuring out how machines work. You’re quiet, independent, and always ready to tackle a new project. Friends know they can come to you when they need something fixed, and you love the challenge of solving practical problems with ingenuity.
